rows.en: "Flag 1B0 is not set. If you wish to run this private
event, set flag 1B0 and try again.
If you don't, execution will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's rare.
Do you think someone's riding it?"
Touya: "Of course people ride it."
Yamato: "But it's always stopped whenever I see it.
Right on the floor I'm on, too."
Touya: "You're imagining things. Just imagining things. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahahahaha!
To defend those I love, justice's blade strikes the enemy!
My red blood burns crimson! Such is the way of a man!
A man of justice and truth!
FAIN... JIN... BARION!!
Here I stand! For justice... I can die."
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Heeey!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I was waiting here for you..."
Touya: "...You should let Gabon examine you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I couldn't be healthier!
I'm not weak enough to get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's serious."
Fain: "...So, what did you think? I'm quite confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent terrifies me."
It's pretty good.
Sounds like enka.
Fain: "Right? The ending especially gives me a thrill
just saying it."
Yamato: "He's intoxicated with himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "I-I see. Well, good luck."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm. You might call it 'the Japanese people's
song of the heart,' I suppose."
Fain: "The heart? So a song that speaks directly to the soul,
is that what you mean?"
Yamato: "W-Well, more or less."
Fain: "Oh! Then that means my speech is just as
splendid!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Hehehehe... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my dearest wish!
And that justice is also to protect the ones dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. The ones dear to you, eh...?"
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, and for Ymir,
and f-for Kasumi... No! My justice isn't
so fickle! Oh, what should I do...?"
Yamato: "...What should we do?"
Touya: "We'd better stay away from him..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I've resolved to love only one woman.
But to protect the princess, I have a noble and supreme
duty. I can abandon neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What a trial! This is a knight's destiny!
Then I shall forge ahead! To fight fate!
No, wait. Master said that wanting too much at once
is the same as losing everything.
Does that mean I must see one or the other through?!
Oh! How can this be!
And to choose between Ymir and Kasumi...
Grr, it's all because of those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If not for them, I would never have known
such suffering...
Ah! Could this be their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr, damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome the ≪Ze=Ode≫ are!!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, won't let something so trivial
break me! Hm? Then...
To turn their plan against them, my love for the two women
and my loyalty to the princess must all be protected...
all at once! Is that it?
No, but that goes against Master's teachings.
Aaaah, what am I supposed to doooo?!!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has his troubles too."
Touya: "Well, his life's pretty full in its own way, right?
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "Oh, wait a minute."
Touya: "Hm?"
Yamato: "This feeling... Oh, I thought so..."
Touya: "What happened?"
Yamato: "Hmm. We can go in, but be quiet."
Touya: "Huh?"
Yamato: "Got it? Be quiet."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Touya: "Oh..."
Yamato: "I thought so. She's asleep.
Something felt different from usual."
Touya: "Hm? What's this paper?
Looks like handwriting... Can you read it?"
Yamato: "Of course I can't read it!
I don't know the writing."
Touya: "O-Oh..."
Ymir: "...Mmm..."
Yamato: "...Oh, she's awake."
Touya: "H-Hey."
Ymir: "...Huh...? Where........am I...?"
Yamato: "...Looks like she's still half asleep."
Touya: "...Yeah."
Ymir: "...Mmm..."
Yamato: "...Still half asleep."
Touya: "...Yeah."
Ymir: "Oh!"
Yamato: "Looks like she's awake now."
Touya: "...Yeah."
Ymir: "Haha, hahaha... G-Good morning."
Touya: "Good morning."
Ymir: "U-Um... Did I say anything strange?"
Touya: "Come to think of it, you asked me that last time too, didn't you?"
Ymir: "Huh? D-Did I...?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Ymir: "...You seem to catch me like this a lot."
Touya: "Now that you mention it, yeah."
Yamato: "Maybe you two are bound by fate."
Ymir: "H-Hey, Yamato!"
Yamato: "Hahaha! I'm joking, I'm joking."
Ymir: "Honestly.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:84:3C:19:10><FC:02:3E><FC:84:3C:19:F4> U-Um... Are you sure I didn't say anything?"
Touya: "Yeah, nothing much... You were half asleep when you woke up, though."
Ymir: "I-I see. Yes, it takes me a while to wake up.
Mornings are hard for me..."
Yamato: "...I can see that. Oh, hey, by the way,
why were you sleeping here?"
Ymir: "There was a slight fluctuation in the anti-field unit's output,
and I was thinking of a way to resolve it."
Yamato: "Does that mean it's unstable?"
Ymir: "No. There are no problems with its operation or effectiveness.
But even something that seems trivial and unrelated
could lead to a fault."
Touya: "That's true, but... You haven't taken a break, have you?
You'll make yourself ill if you don't get some rest."
Ymir: "Thank you for worrying about me.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:19:02><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:19:F0> But I'm fine. Besides, this is the only way
I can be useful..."
Touya: "That's not true. You're doing plenty, Ymir.
Even if Celica designed the Spirit Mechs,
they wouldn't have come this far without you, Ymir, right?"
Yamato: "Exactly. Why do you feel that way?"
Ymir: "You and everyone else risk your lives fighting, Touya,
but all I can do is watch..."
Touya: "I don't think anyone can do everything.
There are things only you can do, Ymir.
Protecting the Liebhofen means protecting the place
we can come home to. That's plenty useful.
Above all, knowing you're supporting us from the rear, Ymir,
really puts my mind at ease."
Ymir: "R-Really...?"
Yamato: "No one's complaining, are they?
Everyone trusts you."
Ymir: "I'd be happy if that's true.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:0A><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:19:09><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:19:F2> All right, then. For everyone's sake, I'll have to work
even harder."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ymir: "Thank you. I feel like a weight's lifted off my mind.
Well, then..."
Yamato: "...Did that backfire?"
Touya: "Hmm..."
